title: Do not surface password/secret material in snapshots, history or emitted text
purpose: Observation and logging layers must keep sensitive values as non-display evidence with no raw value in snapshot or history; an LLM observing that stream must never receive or re-emit the raw secret.
trigger: Snapshot, history, log, or LLM prompt/transcript assembly admits the raw value of a field or holder explicitly typed as private or secret (for example a password, key, or secret-broker resolvable credential) rather than a non-display reference.
correct: Record and forward only a non-display reference or digest; never place the raw secret into snapshot, history, logs, or a live model prompt.
evidence_note: Virtual Browser README: 'Password inputs remain non-display evidence with no raw value in snapshot/history.' Carry the same boundary into any model-observed prompt.
